name: Muscle Strain
commonSymptoms: Pain, stiffness, muscle weakness, and limited movement in the affected area.
possibleCauses: Overuse, sudden movements, lifting heavy objects, or improper warm-up before activity.
basicCare: Rest the affected muscle, avoid intense activity, and apply ice if swelling appears.
whenToSeeProfessional: If pain is severe, persists for several days, or limits normal movement.

name: Ankle Sprain
commonSymptoms: Swelling, bruising, pain when walking, and instability in the ankle.
possibleCauses: Twisting the ankle, sudden changes in direction, or landing incorrectly.
basicCare: Limit movement, keep the ankle elevated, and avoid putting weight on it if painful.
whenToSeeProfessional: If walking is difficult, swelling is severe, or pain does not improve.

name: Muscle Tear
commonSymptoms: Sharp pain, swelling, bruising, and significant loss of strength.
possibleCauses: Sudden forceful movement, heavy lifting, or intense physical activity.
basicCare: Stop activity immediately, rest the area, and avoid further strain.
whenToSeeProfessional: If there is intense pain, visible bruising, or inability to use the muscle.

name: Tendonitis
commonSymptoms: Pain around a joint, tenderness, and stiffness that worsens with movement.
possibleCauses: Repetitive motion, overuse, or poor technique during physical activity.
basicCare: Reduce repetitive movements, rest the joint, and monitor discomfort.
whenToSeeProfessional: If pain persists, worsens over time, or limits daily activities.

name: Lower Back Pain
commonSymptoms: Dull or sharp pain in the lower back, stiffness, and difficulty bending or lifting.
possibleCauses: Poor posture, prolonged sitting, lifting incorrectly, or muscle imbalance.
basicCare: Avoid prolonged sitting, maintain gentle movement, and be mindful of posture.
whenToSeeProfessional: If pain is constant, radiates to the legs, or affects daily function.
